body:
oh ok, the Mapped part, which is wrong to have here but should not crash, is also a symptom of the problem that it's trying to treat this attr as mapped.

but any other attribute that is a dict shouldnt try to be treated as mapped either...
oh it's becasue of the declared attr, right.  got it.

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **main** branch:

**exclude special names from @declared_attr check** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/3310

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **rel_1_4** branch:

**exclude special names from @declared_attr check** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/3311

The proposed fix appears to fix the crash. However, if I add a type annotation `cls: Type['Foo']`, there's a warning
```
test.py:12: error: The erased type of self "Type[test.Foo]" is not a supertype of its class "test.Foo"
```
This warning does not appear prior to the proposed fix.

again this is not related to the "fix", the plugin itself is interpreting "anything" as a mapped attribute, and that is handling the attribute in this case.  in the case of ``__mapper_args__`` etc these are not mapped attributes and should not be counted by the plugin as mapped, which is why it was crashing.   

turn off the plugin and your example above produces mypy errors related to Base and does not get as far as the `@declared_attr`.
ill try to modify this so that it still rewrites those lines, beacuse I think otherwise if there is no `@classmethod` then this form isn't possible w/ mypy

mypy will see them rewritten as:

   ``__mapper_args__: Any``

this is not as ideal as actually validating that these are written correctly, but it's better than a false error.
that's in the gerrit now if you want to look again

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **main** branch:

**use typing.Dict** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/3323

**Mike Bayer** has proposed a fix for this issue in the **rel_1_4** branch:

**use typing.Dict** https://gerrit.sqlalchemy.org/c/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/+/3324
